landing.title: Activity Test
landing.subtitle: 54 questions. About 30–40 minutes. An AI-generated interpretation will be emailed to you.
landing.privacy: Your answers and email are stored in a secure database (Supabase, EU region) so we can send you your interpretation and improve the test. Data is not shared with third parties. To delete your data, email the project owner. This test is not a substitute for professional psychological or career counseling.

test.pasteResultUrl: Paste your Lüscher result link or text here
test.emailStepBody: Enter the email address where you want to receive your results. We'll send you a copy of your answers and the AI-generated interpretation to this address. The email is only used to deliver your results and is stored with your submission so you can request data deletion later.
test.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address
test.emailConsent: I agree to have my answers stored and to receive my submitted answers and the AI interpretation at this email address.
test.validationError: Please complete the required fields before submitting.
test.rankDuplicate: Each rank must be used exactly once.

confirmation.title: Thanks! Your answers are in.
confirmation.body: Your interpretation will arrive at {email} within about 5 minutes. If it's not there in 15 minutes, please check your spam folder.

errors.submitFailed: Could not submit your answers. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: You've already submitted recently. Please try again later.
